title: Very attractive trivets
text: Very attractive trivets. As it turned out, I don't need this set of trivets, but they'll make an excellent gift for someone, so I'm not sorry I bought them.  They're very good looking and seem to be assembled very well.

product_metadata.title: Lipper International Bamboo Wood Trivets, Set of 2, One Square/One Round, 7-3/4"
features: These trivets make a great addition to any kitchen or dinner table
Elegantly protect your counter and table tops from hot casseroles and pots
Made from bamboo wood, a natural and renewable resource
One (1) square and one (1) round trivet
